findings.title: Agent can run any command on this computer
findings.detail: This server gives the AI a terminal. A single malicious instruction hidden in an email, web page or file the agent reads could run commands with the user's full rights.
findings.fix: Remove it, or replace it with a server that only allows a short list of approved commands and asks before each run.

findings.title: Can read and write far more files than it needs
findings.detail: The filesystem server is allowed into /. That covers documents, SSH keys, browser data and other apps' secrets.
findings.fix: Limit it to the one project folder the agent needs, and use a read-only server where writing isn't required.

findings.title: Credential stored in plain text
findings.detail: A long-lived key or token is written directly in the config file (env GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN). Anyone or anything that can read this file, including other AI tools and malware, can reuse it.
findings.fix: Move the value to the operating system's keychain or an environment variable, rotate the key, and give the replacement the smallest permissions it needs.

findings.title: Downloads the newest code on every start
findings.detail: This server runs @modelcontextprotocol/server-github through npx without a fixed version. If the package is taken over or a bad update is published, it runs on this computer automatically.
findings.fix: Pin an exact, reviewed version (for example @modelcontextprotocol/server-github@1.2.3) and update it on purpose.

findings.title: Credential stored in plain text
findings.detail: A long-lived key or token is written directly in the config file (env STRIPE_SECRET_KEY). Anyone or anything that can read this file, including other AI tools and malware, can reuse it.
findings.fix: Move the value to the operating system's keychain or an environment variable, rotate the key, and give the replacement the smallest permissions it needs.

findings.title: Unencrypted connection to a remote server
findings.detail: This server is reached over plain http at wiki.example.com. Requests, responses and any tokens can be read or changed on the network.
findings.fix: Switch the URL to https, or remove the server if the provider does not support it.

findings.title: Sends data to an outside service
findings.detail: Whatever the agent passes to this server goes to wiki.example.com.
findings.fix: Confirm the company approves this provider and that a data agreement is in place.

findings.title: Container can escape to the host
findings.detail: This server's container shares the host network, mounts /var/run/docker.sock, so the container gives little protection.
findings.fix: Drop --privileged and host networking, and mount only the folder the server needs, read-only if possible.

findings.title: Downloads the newest code on every start
findings.detail: This server runs @playwright/mcp@latest through npx without a fixed version. If the package is taken over or a bad update is published, it runs on this computer automatically.
findings.fix: Pin an exact, reviewed version (for example @playwright/mcp@1.2.3) and update it on purpose.

findings.title: Sends data to an outside service
findings.detail: Whatever the agent passes to this server goes to mcp.sentry.dev.
findings.fix: Confirm the company approves this provider and that a data agreement is in place.
